title: Brown compactness tested on arbitrary representatives
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative condensed coefficient ring. Let S=Dctf(X,Λ) and L=Loc(S) [sk-def-localizing-closure], with the compactness notion [def-pc-compact-object] and Brown bundle characterized in [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion]. Let g:G→S be any family such that every C in S is isomorphic in the ambient derived category to some g(i). No category structure on G, skeletal condition, or restriction to the coproduct indexing universe is assumed. Then BrownHypothesesFor Λ X is equivalent to S being triangulated, isomorphism-closed, retract-closed and essentially small in the fixed universe, together with a fixed-universe coproduct structure on L for which every lift of every g(i) to L is compact. This is a criterion conditional on compactness; it does not assert compactness over an arbitrary field.

source.place: paragraphs 1--2: compact representatives, transport by isomorphisms and orthogonal generation

proof.text: Lift each representative g(i) canonically to L using localizing-closure minimality. Obtain the canonical triangulation from the structural theorem. For any object K with underlying object in S, choose the supplied isomorphism K.obj≅g(i). Fullness lifts it to K≅E_i in L. The thick envelope of the E_i and zero objects contains E_i and is replete, hence contains K. Apply the thick-generator compactness criterion. Membership proofs in full-subcategory objects are propositionally unique, so its compactness condition is exactly compactness for every lift in the original representative criterion.

theorem brownHypothesesFor_iff_compact_representatives
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (X : Scheme.{u})
    {G : Type*} (g : G → ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ X)
    (hG : ∀ C : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ X,
      ∃ i : G, Nonempty (C.obj ≅ (g i).obj)) :
    BrownHypothesesFor Λ X ↔
      let S := constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X ⊓
        fun K ↦ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K
      S.IsTriangulated ∧ S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧ S.IsStableUnderRetracts ∧
        ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} S ∧
        ∃ hSums : HasCoproducts.{u + 1} (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
          letI := hSums
          ∀ (hL : ∀ i, localizingClosureProEtale Λ X (g i).obj) (i : G),
            IsCompactObject (⟨(g i).obj, hL i⟩ :
              (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
